titles.title: Article titles
titles.description: Article names to look up, one per line, e.g. Berlin, Quantum computing. Leave empty to use keyword search below instead.

search.title: Keyword search (no titles needed)
search.description: Find articles by keyword instead of exact titles, e.g. electric cars. Ignored when titles are given.

searchLimit.title: Search results
searchLimit.description: How many articles to pull when using keyword search.

language.title: Language
language.description: Wikipedia language edition, e.g. en (English), es, de, fr, ja.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on articles returned. Controls total cost. First 2 rows per run are free; missing articles are always free.
